feedback:
Approved for the race. The candidate is the iteration 8 design (score 430.6, best raced so far) with one controller change: kp 2.5 to 3.0. Geometry, kd 0.8, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.1, weights [-1.5 to 1.5] and last_direction are unchanged from iteration 8, so any shift in the per-track results can be attributed to kp.

The evidence supports testing kp. Iteration 8 finished all 20 oval trials at 1.87 s with steering_oscillation 0.17. Its s-bend and slalom trials still ended off track at max_error about 0.062 to 0.063 m, just over the 0.06 m limit, with slalom progress stuck at 0.18 and about 1 line-loss event per run. Iteration 6 and 7 designs were not raced, so the 1.5 outer weights have only been tested once, in iteration 8.

The risk is that the effective gain at the edges rises by about 20 percent over iteration 8 (turn up to about 4.5 at full signal). Iteration 2 showed that higher kp with a larger footprint and kd 1.0 cut oval finishes from 0.9 to 0.55, and iteration 4 showed kd 1.0 cost oval finishes. The oval is therefore the main thing to read in this race.

What to do with the race result, judged per track: if the oval still finishes 20 of 20 with steering_oscillation at or below about 0.3 and slalom max_error falls below about 0.055 m, keep kp 3.0 and look for further gain. If the oval drops below about 0.9 completion or steering_oscillation rises above 0.3, return kp to 2.5 (iteration 8) and try kp 2.7 or outer weights of about 1.2 instead. If slalom and s-bend still show line_loss_events near 1 with max_error at or above 0.06 m, the limit is not turn authority alone, and the next lever is sensor y or line_loss mode.
requested_changes: If the oval completion stays at 20 of 20 and steering_oscillation is at or below about 0.3, while slalom max_error falls below about 0.055 m: keep kp 3.0 and try kp 3.3 to test further turn authority, since iteration 8 showed oval steering_oscillation of 0.17 with kp 2.5.

If the oval completion drops below about 0.9 or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.3 (iteration 2 and 4 showed higher effective gain or kd cut oval finishes): return kp to 2.5 and try kp 2.7, or reduce outer sensor_weights to about 1.2 with kp 3.0 to keep the effective gain near iteration 8.

If slalom and s-bend still show line_loss_events near 1 with max_error at or above 0.06 m at kp 3.0: keep kp 3.0 and change line_loss from last_direction to search_right, or move sensor y, since iteration 5 (y 0.08) did not fix the bends and gain alone did not change line loss.
